rationale: SKM gapped up 6.22% with no news catalyst, which makes the move difficult to interpret directionally — it could be a sustained gap-and-go or a fade setup, but without a clear catalyst the edge is ambiguous. Price is sitting at 88% of today's range near the session high with very low recent 1-minute volume (mostly 1,000–3,000 shares per bar except one spike), suggesting momentum is stalling rather than confirming a breakout. The spread and liquidity are acceptable, but the lack of a news driver and the indeterminate price structure at this level offer no reliable mechanical edge in either direction.
